citation.title: Effects of trehalose ingestion on exercise performance and energy metabolism during prolonged exercise (Wingate test and 40% VO2peak constant-load exercise)

population.description: Part 2 participants: 24 healthy recreationally trained college men (age 21.9 ± 1.2 y, weight 66.2 ± 5.8 kg, height 173.4 ± 5.6 cm, VO2peak 2988.5 mL/min); BMI not printed. Separate people from Part 1.

protocols.name: part2_water
protocols.description: Part 2 (Methods 2.2.2): fasted from 21:00 the evening before, examinations from 09:00 (12 h by the clock, derived); 5 min rest, then constant-load cycling at 40% VO2peak for 30 min, then the test drink within 5 min, then the same exercise for 60 more min. Clock assumed: rest 0-5, drink at minute 35 (end of the 30 min), the 60 min after ingestion run to minute 95, exercise held continuously from 5 to 96 (the 5-min drinking period is not shown as a pause). Intensity: Table 2 VO2 at 40% VO2peak 1195.4 mL/min / body weight 66.2 kg = 18.06 mL/kg/min; level = (18.06 - 3.7) / 31.7 = 0.453. Drink: water (500 mL), entered as no meal. The paper's minutes after ingestion (30 and 60 min, points 7 and 10; 40 min, point 8) are printed in the text but counted from an unstated point of the 5-min drink (start or end); they are placed from the drink at minute 35, and Figure 2 is not in the text.

protocols.name: part2_glucose
protocols.description: Part 2 (Methods 2.2.2): fasted from 21:00 the evening before, examinations from 09:00 (12 h by the clock, derived); 5 min rest, then constant-load cycling at 40% VO2peak for 30 min, then the test drink within 5 min, then the same exercise for 60 more min. Clock assumed: rest 0-5, drink at minute 35 (end of the 30 min), the 60 min after ingestion run to minute 95, exercise held continuously from 5 to 96 (the 5-min drinking period is not shown as a pause). Intensity: Table 2 VO2 at 40% VO2peak 1195.4 mL/min / body weight 66.2 kg = 18.06 mL/kg/min; level = (18.06 - 3.7) / 31.7 = 0.453. Drink: 500 mL of an 8% glucose solution; carbohydrate = 500 mL x 0.08 = 40 g (the paper prints no unit for the 8%; read as g per 100 mL, derived, so the grams are not stated). The paper's minutes after ingestion (30 and 60 min, points 7 and 10; 40 min, point 8) are printed in the text but counted from an unstated point of the 5-min drink (start or end); they are placed from the drink at minute 35, and Figure 2 is not in the text.

findings.description: RER (respiratory exchange ratio, entered as rq) in the water trial of Part 2 at the points the text prints: 30 and 60 min after drink ingestion (points 7 and 10 in Figure 9), minutes 65 and 95 of the arm. Mean +/- SD (Methods 2.4).

location.where: Results 3.4, Part 2 RER paragraph (points 7 to 10 of Figure 9)

findings.description: RER (entered as rq) in the water trial of Part 2 at point 8, 40 min after ingestion (minute 75 of the arm), single value. Mean +/- SD.

location.where: Results 3.4, Part 2 RER paragraph (point 8 of Figure 9)
location.quote: it decreased markedly in the WAT trial (0.92 ± 0.04 to 0.91 ± 0.04)

findings.description: RER (entered as rq) in the glucose trial of Part 2 at 30 and 60 min after ingestion (points 7 and 10 of Figure 9; the text gives the range 0.97 to 0.96 for points 7 to 10), minutes 65 and 95. Mean +/- SD.

location.where: Results 3.4, Part 2 RER paragraph (points 7 to 10 of Figure 9)
